description: This file declares functions related to graphics settings and style configurations for a Lua-C binding, including functions for background, fill, stroke, transformations, and style stack operations, as well as some constants for rectangle modes.

methods.name: background
methods.description: Sets the background color with various parameter options, callable from Lua scripts.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Sets the fill color for shapes, supporting multiple parameter types including color name and hex.

methods.name: strokeWeight
methods.description: Sets the line width in pixels.

methods.name: stroke
methods.description: Sets the stroke color for shapes, supporting multiple parameter options.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Saves the current style and transformation state onto the stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Restores the most recently saved style and transformation state.

methods.name: rectMode
methods.description: Sets rectangle alignment mode, choosing among CENTER, CORNER, RADIUS.

methods.name: debugMode
methods.description: Enables or disables 3D debug mode for visualization.
